basic.name: Healing Pathogen
basic.description:
Infest an allied Hero with a Healing Pathogen that heals the target for 222~~0.04~~ Health over 4.5 seconds. Healing Pathogens can spread to a nearby allied Hero every 0.75 seconds.

Each cast of Healing Pathogen can only spread to each allied Hero 1 time.

basic.name: Weighted Pustule
basic.description: Hurl a pustule that impacts all enemy Heroes in its path, dealing 20~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing by 5%, increasing to 50% over 3 seconds. Deals an additional 88~~0.04~~ damage upon expiring or being removed.

basic.name: Lurking Arm
basic.description:
Channel at a target location, creating an area that deals 136~~0.04~~ damage per second to non-Structure enemies and Silences them. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes.

Does not cost Mana while Channeling, and lasts until canceled or interrupted.

heroic.name: Massive Shove
heroic.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

heroic.name: Flailing Swipe
heroic.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 62~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

trait.name: Bio-Kill Switch
trait.description:
Activate to detonate all of Stukov's Viruses. Each Healing Pathogen heals its target for 435~~0.04~~ Health, and each Weighted Pustule does 100~~0.04~~ damage and Slows its target by 70% for 2 seconds.

Can be cast while Channeling Lurking Arm.

activable.name: Melee Attacks
activable.description:
Basic Attacks are melee.

Toggle to have Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but they deal 35% less damage.

activable.name: Reactive Ballistospores
activable.description:
Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.

Passive: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.

level1.name: Fetid Touch
level1.description:
Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but deal 35% less damage. This effect can be toggled.

Quest: Hit Heroes with Weighted Pustule.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Weighted Pustule by 5 seconds and remove its Mana cost.

level1.name: Low Blow
level1.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

level1.name: Reactive Ballistospores
level1.description:
Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.

Passive: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.

level4.name: One Good Spread...
level4.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

level4.name: Biotic Armor
level4.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

level4.name: Vigorous Reuptake
level4.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

level7.name: The Long Pitch
level7.description: Increase the range of Weighted Pustule by 50%. Detonating 2 or more Weighted Pustules causes Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch and Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Growing Infestation
level7.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

level7.name: Targeted Excision
level7.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

level10.name: Flailing Swipe
level10.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 62~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

level10.name: Massive Shove
level10.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

level13.name: It Hungers
level13.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

level13.name: Virulent Reaction
level13.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

level13.name: Poppin' Pustules
level13.description: Detonating Weighted Pustule with Bio-Kill Switch within 1.5 seconds of its expiration increases its damage by 150% and applies its damage and Slow in an area. Enemy Heroes hit have a Weighted Pustule applied to them.

level16.name: Superstrain
level16.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300~~0.04~~ Health.

level16.name: Universal Carrier
level16.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

level16.name: Pox Populi
level16.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

level20.name: Controlled Chaos
level20.description: Flailing Swipe gains 2 additional charges, but each use only swings 1 time, at maximum range. Additionally, its cooldown is decreased to 25 seconds, and its Mana cost is reduced from 60 to 25.

level20.name: Push Comes To Shove
level20.description: Massive Shove Slows its target by 50% for 4 seconds upon colliding with terrain. If Massive Shove pushes a target for more than 1.25 seconds, its cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds.

level20.name: Top Off
level20.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

level20.name: Bio-Explosion Switch
level20.description: Bio-Kill Switch now also detonates Lurking Arm, dealing 230~~0.04~~ damage, applying a Weighted Pustule, and Silencing enemy Heroes inside for 2.5 seconds.
